question: Prime Minister Narendra Modi officially launched the Central Sector Scheme ________, for artisans and crafts persons across India in September 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**PM Vishwakarma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **PM Vishwakarma** is the name of the **Central Sector Scheme** launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in **September 2023**.
 
• The scheme aims to support artisans and crafts persons across India.
 
•
